column1: Unfortunately, when the farmer makes his production decision, he does not know the relative price of asparagus. As an asparagus producer, he monitors the asparagus market closely and always knows the nominal price of asparagus. But he does not know the prices of all the other goods in the economy. He must, therefore, estimate the relative price of asparagus using the nominal price of asparagus and his expectation of the overall price level.
